data.title: Marine Wind Warning for Victoria
data.message:
IDV20600

Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology
Victoria

Marine Wind Warning Summary for Victoria

Issued at 10:00 am EST on Tuesday 18 August 2026
for the period until midnight EST Wednesday 19 August 2026.

Wind Warnings for Wednesday 19 August

Strong Wind Warning for the following areas:
Port Phillip, West Coast, Central Coast and East Gippsland Coast

The next marine wind warning summary will be issued by 4:15 pm EST Tuesday.

Check the latest Coastal Waters Forecast or Local Waters Forecast for information on wind, wave and weather conditions for these coastal zones.
